A chance to help a neighbor is coming to the Center square this Thursday.

Farmers State Bank is hosting a community blood drive on November 12, from 10 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. The Gulf Coast Regional Blood Center donor coach will be at 115 Shelbyville Street in Center.

Appointments are preferred, and walk-ins are welcome according to the organizer’s announcement. Check the blood center’s appointment page for donation information and available times before heading over; it can help you plan your visit.

If someone in your family, workplace, or neighborhood has been looking for a local opportunity to donate, please pass along the details. A shared reminder can reach a neighbor who might otherwise miss it.

Appointment information:
https://www.commitforlife.org/donor/schedules/drive_schedule/407330

posts.topic: Veterans Day thanks and Joaquin public program
posts.facebook:
To the veterans who call Shelby County home: thank you for your service, and for the many ways you continue to care for this community.

For neighbors looking for a local observance today, Joaquin ISD has invited the public to its Veterans Day program on Wednesday, November 11, at 9 a.m. in the high-school gym.

The district’s invitation also notes a small reception afterward in the high-school library for veterans and their families. That reception is separate from the public program. Please check the district’s latest information before attending.

Whether you attend a program or take a quiet moment to thank someone you know, there is room for a simple, sincere expression of appreciation. Please share the invitation with a veteran or family member who may find it useful.

District information:
https://www.joaquinisd.net/live-feed/

#ShelbyCounty #EastTexas #VeteransDay

posts.topic: Five questions before choosing a car quote
posts.facebook:
Comparing car insurance quotes in Center? Put the written details side by side before deciding what a different price means.

Five questions are worth taking along:
• Are the same drivers, vehicles, and uses listed?
• Are the limits and deductibles the same?
• Is the total cost for the same policy period and payment plan?
• Are any drivers or uses excluded?
• Which details or discounts still need verification?

The Texas Department of Insurance recommends comparing quotes and asking about policy terms, not just the premium. Our existing Center comparison guide offers a plain-language way to organize those questions.

Save this list for your next renewal conversation. Which part of a quote is hardest to compare? General questions are welcome, but please keep policy numbers and document photos out of public comments.

Read the comparison guide:
https://morrison-ins.net/resources/car-insurance-companies-center-tx

#CenterTX #ShelbyCounty #EastTexas
